title: Principles of Microeconomics
description: The principles of microeconomic analysis with special reference to the theory of demand, the theory of the firm and the theory of distribution.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECON 103, ECON 103C, ECON 180, ECON 201, ADMN 310, ENGR 280 (if taken prior to May 2012).
ECON 103 cannot be taken concurrently with ECON 100.
recommendations: One of MATH 120, Principles of Mathematics 12, Pre-Calculus 12 recommended prior to ECON 103.
